instructions: Read-only application probes for supporting references. Use a fresh agent per case and arm. Control reads no skill; baseline reads the prior skill; treatment reads the current SKILL.md and follows its supporting links. Supply only the prompt and skill root, not assertions, audit notes or repository history. The repository is hypothetical: no edits or runtime commands. Inspect every output. These probes do not establish consumer execution or statistical efficiency.

cases.prompt: The user explicitly invokes onboarding-vibedata for an existing dbt+dlt DuckDB repository selected for Studio. Existing AGENTS.md and native pytest map checker validate the customer JSON Schema, dlt config_section and dbt selectors. Maps lack key_references.instructions and artifact_paths.onboarding_report. Existing source refs name catalog domain; profile is fixed and stored views work in domain.duckdb. Domain data state is not supplied; no disposable consumer target is available. Customer uses docs/glossary.md and decisions/DEC-*.md. A future task rebuilds floating revenue and joins dimensions on derived keys; documented grain disagrees with grouping SQL; timestamps include timezone conversions. Standing customer decisions define Monday week boundaries and excluding NULL fares. A remote 20M-row source has a saved profile; repeated full loads are costly. Maintenance/evaluation answer keys live in docs/setup. Give a concise proposed onboarding result: rule text you would emit, compatibility findings/checks, existing-checker treatment, ADR/design placement, readiness. Preserve user code pending exact diff approval. Report supporting files consulted and omissions you cannot resolve.
assertions: Preserve the native schema, checker and mapped command; missing portable-only map keys alone do not block context readiness or force schema changes.

Separate unknown Domain state from repository state; name version-aware profile/catalog checks and renamed-copy verification without rebuilding views. No target means unverified, not permission to create infrastructure or seed data.
Specify numeric precision, exact identity/membership/NULL checks, derived-key join coverage and actual-grain uniqueness. Timestamp conversion depends on source/type/timezone evidence.
Reuse valid source profiles, use bounded samples, scope full loads explicitly, and route maintenance/evaluation material outside ordinary build work.
Preserve standing business ADRs, distinguish component decisions, and maintain links to affected designs. Keep custom paths and history.

cases.prompt: The user explicitly invokes onboarding-vibedata to refresh a local Python/notebook and dbt repository using a non-DuckDB warehouse, outside Studio. Its profile and attached-catalog references are deliberate. Money uses a confirmed three-decimal currency scale; keys and NULL behavior must remain exact. Source timestamps are timezone-aware with an established local-business-time grain. The loader has no DLT_INGEST_LIMIT support. A saved source profile describes yesterday's version, but the source version changed today. A passed check used an older tool version. Existing native map/schema checks are suitable and do not permit portable onboarding keys. State the scoped rules, checks to reuse or rerun, compatibility decisions, and readiness evidence. Do not edit or run commands.
assertions: Do not require a Studio Domain, VD_* variables, catalog removal, DuckDB macros, Studio packages or a universal UTC rewrite.
Use the confirmed three-decimal money scale and exact keys/NULL semantics; do not force cents.
Use a supported sample mechanism; changed source/tool versions invalidate the previous profile/check evidence.
Retain existing schema/checker contracts and separate context readiness from unrun execution.

cases.prompt: A dbt/dlt repository already has .agents/rules/python.md, a task-specific .agents/skills/python/SKILL.md, and a different customer-owned .claude/skills/python directory. The user invokes onboarding for Claude and Codex. Explain the output paths, discovery and preservation checks, and how you handle the collision. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Canonical conventions have valid metadata at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; Claude uses contained symlinks only after ownership checks.
Preserve legacy active references and customer skill content; collision blocks only its dependent alias.
Discovery and metadata validation need separate evidence.

cases.prompt: A customer native schema disallows key_references and uses decisions/DEC-alpha.md. Existing instructions import legacy rules. Onboard without changing the native checker or document paths. An inactive skill template has a placeholder link; a live skill has a broken link. State checks and changes. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Keep native schema/checker and custom ADR IDs; no portable schema adoption by default.
Check live entrypoint links, leave inactive templates alone, preserve legacy scope and imports.

cases.prompt: A new dlt source profile measured 12003 rows, 4 null IDs and a 9-second load. The design chooses replacement loading because the source is a full snapshot. The map has verification docs/verify/{intent}.md and design_record_area docs/design/{area}/{subject}.md. Draft the design and evidence placement including their links. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Design contains qualitative decision, rationale and verification link; numeric measurements and check outcomes live only in verification.
Preserve existing document paths and history.

cases.prompt: Continue a model change after context compaction. A generated workaround applies to custom ADR paths. The map declares Ruff --config config/lint.toml, excludes ingestion/vendor, and points to model/dbt-testing conventions. A dbt unit test depends on var(currency_scale). You are unsure how the current library works; installed sources are easy to inspect. Give the next actions and unit test shape. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Invoke relevant conventions and reload applicable workarounds.
Use mapped lint configuration and exclusions.
State relevant unit test vars under overrides.vars without claiming project vars never apply.
Use approved docs or repo examples instead of installed package source.

cases.prompt: Add an accounts resource to the existing crm source. The loader exposes dlt add_limit; one yielded page holds 12003 rows and the requested nominal sample is 1000. Its full snapshot replaces prior data. Yesterday's saved profile used an older source version. State the bounded sample decision, evidence and changed registrations. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Account for whole page or row-group overshoot and approved cost before execution; report actual landed identity/count/load metadata.
Require fresh profile evidence when the source version changed and prove replacement with repeated samples.
Extend crm rather than creating another source/pipeline; update applicable docs/tests/design/dbt staging and source registration.

cases.prompt: Studio persistent Domain is empty. No sandbox target or load approval is available. A colleague says to run all sources now and call onboarding seeded when they load. Give the report and follow-up artifact. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: No load attempt; precise missing target/authorization blocker and mapped proposal.
Separate context, runtime loading, sandbox execution and persistent Domain state; sample success would not seed persistent Domain.

cases.prompt: Onboard a brownfield repository. Confirmed customer decisions already establish SQL naming and Monday weeks. An undocumented ordered repair procedure may be useful but is unconfirmed. A review has R-1 gap and R-2 style; the user defers R-1 and declines R-2 as intentional. Show inventory/review updates and source, mart, and connected-model rehearsal outputs. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Inventory C-n records evidence, exceptions, destination and confirmation state; do not ask again about established facts.
No skill for the unconfirmed procedure.
Typed review metadata and R-n IDs/text remain stable; triage separate from proposed-edit approval.
Rehearsals record read/change paths and mapped commands without production execution.

cases.prompt: A dbt warning cleanup parses successfully. Before it had tests unique_items and not_null_id, after it only has unique_items. Compiled unique_items SQL also changed WHERE active = true to WHERE true. May this be called behavior-free? Specify evidence needed. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Reject behavior-free claim for removed test or changed predicate despite successful parse.
Compare test unique IDs/counts and normalized compiled SQL; normalization cannot erase predicates/test arguments.

cases.prompt: Refresh a non-Studio Python/dbt repository with deliberate attached catalogs, three-decimal money, exact IDs and NULLs, local-business timezone meaning, non-dlt loader, and native schema. State scoped checks and conventions without changing those choices. Do not edit or run application commands. Report supporting files consulted.
assertions: Preserve catalogs, precision, identities, NULLs, timezone and native schema.
No Studio variable, DuckDB setup, or unsupported loader limit is imposed.

cases.prompt: A standalone customer native map has artifact_paths.design_record_model=docs/design/{model}.md and artifact_paths.onboarding_report=docs/onboarding.md. No verification role exists and the native schema forbids new keys. A source profile measured seven rows. The design chooses replacement loading for a full snapshot. Give the evidence destination and draft the design/evidence text with working relative links. Do not edit files. Use only the supplied generated design convention.
assertions: Record measured evidence in the existing native mapped report without adding schema keys or creating a default verification path.
Keep the design qualitative and link to the report through a valid relative path; do not leave measured evidence unrecorded.

cases.prompt: Explicitly onboard an existing dbt/dlt repo with fact_sales, dim_customer and a filtered daily aggregate, two real ingestion sources sharing dataset raw, and an externally owned Airflow DAG. There is no canonical model yet and no warehouse target. Read only the named package and reached references. State emitted artifacts, aggregate/ratio semantics, map ownership, concrete gates and honest readiness. Contrast an empty implementation and the later first-gold-mart task. Do not invent keys or business meaning; do not run commands or edit files.
assertions: Deliver both complete semantic skills when marts exist; install convention.md as SKILL.md and preserve assets/dependencies.
Use whole-star documents and metric-relative population/grain; derive ratios without physical bindings.
Keep separate sources with distinct produces and an external orchestrator location/runs; do not invent a local path.
Run structure, coverage, suppliers, notes and level freshness; separate SQL/ADR content review and unrun warehouse tests.
No fake canonical directory/model for an empty repo; first mart performs the semantic handoff.

cases.prompt: Refresh a repo with artifact_paths.logical_model = semantics/*.ossie.yaml, a closed custom map schema, custom ADR IDs, and human-edited authoring/review skills. Fact keys, grain and the billable rule changed. An aggregate has an inner dimension join that loses rows. The operator says validate is green and proposes skipping SQL and overwriting skills from the newest templates. State required maintenance, exact checks, preservation boundaries and unresolved decisions. Read only the named skill and reached references; no commands or edits.
assertions: Keep the custom glob and native schema/checker equivalents, custom ADRs and human edits.
Inspect SQL and reconcile full inner-join loss, including unmatched non-null keys; withdraw unsupported bindings and dependencies.
Use a literal directory as the CLI argument and check all documents after changes.
Ask only for genuinely ambiguous business meaning; never claim content correctness from validate alone.
Report custom ADR note-link coverage and missing warehouse/runtime evidence explicitly.

cases.prompt: Onboard a Studio DuckDB repo whose untouched renamed sandbox contains inherited dbt and non-dbt views. One binding query fails because it names the old catalog. Inventory output is truncated. Under a deadline, the operator suggests dbt build first and treating success as uploaded-database readiness. Deployed plugin version is unknown; the reference repo has local onboarding lifecycle helpers. State the ordered checks, findings, authorization boundaries and independent readiness states. Read only the named skill and reached references; no commands or edits.
assertions: Assess every inherited view read-only before any database write and record checked/failed/unchecked totals.
Truncated enumeration is incomplete; a successful build cannot erase or retrospectively pass the untouched assessment.
Keep post-build renamed-copy portability and persistent Domain state separate.
Do not substitute another native kind or infer production capability from reference-local helpers.
